Goal: "Make rocco gym tank as out of stock" requires navigating to the Magento Admin product (catalog) editor or inventory controls and changing the product's stock status / quantity. Therefore none are useful for the specific task of marking the "rocco gym tank" out of stock. The agent will need a different helper that navigates to Catalog -> Products, searches for the product by name ("rocco gym tank"), opens the product edit page, and updates inventory (stock status/quantity) and saves changes.
